      "observations": [
        "All2810owned diff lines across31paths were read, including handwritten extraction/generation/runtime code, nine generated request modules and all generated type changes. Navigation properties are now retained where representable and tracked independently through ExtractedSchema.has_expansions even when no supported expansion variant exists. Selection excludes navigation fields. The generator avoids importing a type into its own module, which matters for recursive MailFolder child folders. This is functional generated-code work, not an excluded bulk regeneration.",
        "Bodyless request generation resolves the OData target from the success body. Pageable NamedSchema CollectionResponse types are mapped to the element type; delta targets stop being collections. Exact query-name/in=query metadata plus a generated target identifier controls selectable/expandable support. Bodyful requests still disable those options in this landing. Six collection/delta outputs and three singleton outputs are read; collection selection changes from the response-wrapper enum to the element enum. Current extraction uses NamedObjectSchema/SUPPORTED_OBJECTS in the later structs/enums split, a separate source phase.",
        "The new Expand trait sets or extends an ordered Vec-backed expansion list. expand replaces; extend_expand appends; no client deduplication occurs. Empty lists emit no pair. The pair key is literal expand without the dollar for all requests, not only delta; its comment attributes this to a Microsoft delta workaround and questions the generality. No real endpoint or specification validation was performed. expand and select options feed one outer form_urlencoded serializer.",
        "ExpandOptions holds one selection and one replaceable filter. Its formatter writes a bare property name when options are empty, otherwise name($select=...;$filter=...). Multiple expansions are comma-joined; nested option pieces are semicolon-joined, then the outer serializer percent-encodes the full value. The existing bounded FilterExpression/identifier lesson is reused; adding this wrapper does not implement general OData or prove every endpoint accepts a generated property.",
        "The owned generator creates explicit Expand enums for syntactically supported named navigation targets, with docs warning that path support is not guaranteed. MessageExpand is initially a zero-variant enum because supported targets are absent. That supplies no ordinary expansion variant, but the stronger comment that any attempt must fail to compile is not independently proved for empty-iterator calls. Current MessageExpand later has SingleValueExtendedProperties and the already-read svlep_expand consumer ORs ID equalities into one expansion filter; neither is introduced by this initial API landing.",
        "Generated navigation getters read PropertyMap with missing-field NotFound and array/object-shape UnexpectedResponse errors, returning borrowed nested values. The generated User created_objects docs say Nullable while its getter requires an array; manager likewise requires an object. Null therefore reaches the unexpected-shape branch in the inspected historical getter rather than a typed optional result. Setters make owned map values and warn that Graph may not expose the property as writable. These are local historical representation facts, not a current owned-serde or server-write contract.",
        "All new/changed test hunks were read. Three extraction tests add negative has-navigation checks without assertion messages; four new expansion-format/URI tests also omit messages. The new production target-type assert has a nonempty should message. The formatting test checks combined nested select/filter; three request tests check outer-select-plus-expand, expand-only and nested select/filter expansion. There is no direct empty-query, replace/append/dedup, missing-field/null getter, positive unsupported-navigation or real-server test here. The earlier filter tests remain separate and no Rust build, test or generator was run.",
        "All queryable generated requests now omit a trailing question mark when the serialized parameter string is empty. This resolves the earlier5137 template behavior in source; the new tests exercise populated queries, not that empty branch. The Select API extend method is renamed extend_selection to distinguish it from extension of expansion properties. Accepted current request code preserves the conditional query delimiter, typed element options and ordering; bodyful-selection/page-size and owned-struct changes are later phases.",
        "Manual style/naming review distinguishes handwritten generator/runtime Rust, emitted template code and generated modules. Generic iterator bounds preserve value-producing collection behavior; field/variant suffixes identify selection versus expansion roles. The self-import comment states the recursive-type constraint. Imported OpenAPI descriptions and source examples remain evidence, not repository-wide comment, loop or formatting rules. Seven new test assertions lack diagnostic messages; no rule is weakened to accept their historical style.",
        "Full primary2029218 current description/comments0–2/activity/end and full D295296 creation-to-final timeline were read from exact retained originals. The primary says expansion is needed for single-value extended properties. The sparse review has no actual inlines or summary histories. The author reports a good Try except macOS10.15 runners that did not start; that is incomplete historical platform execution, not a new test result. Referenced Graph specs, upstream metadata and linked jobs remain unread dependencies.",
        "Current code reuse is bounded: the complete A5137 svlep_expand proof object keeps its original timestamp/bytes/blob and supports only the later consumer. The existing filter grammar/metadata lessons are linked rather than duplicated. Navigation inventory notes were read only for their declared provisional/parser scope and were not used as runtime or ownership evidence."
